thread:
alejandro: FYI several customers just flagged embeddings usage graph showing huge jumps and ambiguous 'units'. Billing escalation incoming from one customer. Screenshot: https://redwood.company/snap/abc123 :grimacing:
support-bot: Created ticket SUP-4521 and linked customer thread (auto).
mika: Can you paste the customer dashboard link + approximate times? want repro steps before escalating to eng.
alejandro: Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/42/metrics?panel=embeddings
Times: spikes around 2027-09-03 14:10 - 14:35 UTC per customer logs. They also reported doubled counts when using batch API.
chris: looking at raw events, I see events.ingest -> embeddings.tasks join is producing multiplicative rows for batched requests. quick snippet of what I'm seeing:
```sql
-- suspicious aggregation
SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) as minute, count(*) as raw_rows
FROM events e
JOIN embeddings b ON b.request_id = e.request_id
WHERE e.org_id = 42
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute desc
LIMIT 10;
```
results show raw_rows ~= batch_size * actual_requests. suspect join key not de-duplicating vector outputs.
eng-metrics: Confirmed. The UI metric "Units" is summing embeddings.rows instead of embeddings.vectors (or tokens), and when batch outputs are expanded in the ETL we count each vector row again. So two issues: unit label mismatch (vectors vs tokens) + duplication from expand step.
mika: Oof. Does this impact billing or just analytics?
eng-metrics: It impacts hosted analytics and the internal dashboard. Billing pipeline uses a separate metering stream that is correct for now, but support tickets have customers seeing spikes and asking for credits. We should still treat as urgent.
sarah: Priority: triage + immediate mitigations. Action items: 1) hide/annotate embeddings 'Units' chart on the public dashboard, 2) run backfill to correct dashboard numbers once fix is merged, 3) evaluate whether any bills were generated from the broken metric. Assigning chris to 1+2, eng-metrics to root cause + fix.
chris: I can put up a quick UI toggle to show 'Vectors (inferred)' vs 'Tokens' and also add a banner: "Metric under investigation". Will open a PR and feature-flag it.
chris: repro steps I'm using locally:
```bash
# simulate batched call
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": ["a","b","c"], "model": "open-embed-1"}' | jq .
# then check events table for request_id expansion
```
with that, the join shows 3 embedding rows for one request. expected UI should count 3 vectors or 1 request depending on selected unit, not double.
mika: For customer-facing comms, recommend: apologize, explain transient dashboard bug (not billing), offer investigatory credit hold and follow-up within 48h.
alejandro: Agreed. I'll draft a short note and queue it with CS. Please post PR link and ETA here.
eng-metrics: Root cause is in the ETL step 'expand_batch_outputs' where we emit an event per vector with same event_id rather than deduping by request_id+vector_index. Quick fix is to dedupe on (request_id, vector_index) before aggregation. Patch coming.
sarah: ETA for patch + UI flag?
chris: PR draft by EOD today, can toggle UI flag immediately. Backfill job probably takes ~2 hours once approved.
eng-metrics: We'll also add a field to the analytics schema 'unit_type' so dashboards explicitly label vectors vs tokens and avoid future confusion.
mika: Thanks. tagging @eng-oncall if any regressions. :thumbsup:
support-bot: SUP-4521 updated: status -> investigating, owner -> chris, sla -> 48h.
alejandro: Good work team. Keep CS looped. I'll push the customer note once we have the banner and a short explanation.
chris: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/eng/1234 (draft). Will update when ready. :eyes:
eng-metrics: After patch deploy, we'll run an aggregation compare to validate numbers: pre_fix vs post_fix and run the backfill with dedupe; will post results here.
sarah: Assign follow-ups to weekly postmortem if needed.
alejandro: last: please collect list of affected org_ids and attach to the ticket.
chris: added initial affected org_ids to SUP-4521.
alejandro: Thanks.
